description:
Cast Pox Plague by paying {B}{B}{B}{B}{B}, causing each player to lose half their life, discard half their hand, and sacrifice half their permanents, rounded down. Ensure that you don't sacrifice Blitzwing
At the beginning of your end step, Blitzwing triggers, causing an opponent to lose life equal to the life they've lost this turn.

uses.name: Blitzwing, Cruel Tormentor // Blitzwing, Adaptive Assailant
